name: Jeremy Heffner
biography: Jeremy Heffner is a software and security professional who has worked on numerous commercial and government projects. His passion is for securing and building scalable, survivable, and fault-tolerant distributed systems. His focus includes cyber attack and defense, information gathering and analysis, and scaling systems globally through automation and dynamic optimization.
